What we found:
You have had blood in stool for 60 days. A problem like this usually settles within 14 days, so it should be tested now rather than treated again [1].

What happens next:
Tests: colonoscopy, fit test, per rectal exam [1]. Come back in 28 days and bring the reports with you [1].

Come back if:
you cough or pass blood, you cannot swallow, you lose more weight, or you feel much worse [1].
